svg.title: How FirstDay Go works
svg.desc: Bee records a training on an Apple Watch or the Bee wearable. Bee’s cloud makes the transcript. Bee’s CLI, in AWS Lambda or on your own computer, brings it to the FirstDay Go app after you OK it. Amazon Bedrock finds each work step with the trainer’s exact words. A trainer shares changes through the coach service (Lambda and DynamoDB), so trainees get a Change Drill, and a voice screen or any MCP client can quiz you. Amazon Cognito handles accounts; S3 and CloudFront serve the web app.
svg.text: From your trainer’s words to your next shift, and on to the whole team

g.text: Bee hears your trainer on an Apple Watch or the Bee wearable.
Bee’s cloud turns the conversation into a transcript, facts and to-dos.
Bee’s own CLI brings it to FirstDay Go, but only after you OK it.
Amazon Bedrock finds each work step and keeps the trainer’s exact words.
The trainer shares the training with the team through the coach service.
Trainees get a Change Drill. A voice screen or any MCP client can quiz you.
Bee → Bee’s CLI → FirstDay Go → Amazon Bedrock → the coach service → the team

svg.text: Black shows what is happening now. The dashed route, Bee’s CLI on your own computer, is optional.
